# AI Value Exploration Notes

> Public working notes in Japanese on value uncertainty, epistemic foundations, exploratory optionality, advanced AI agency, extinction/succession, and value lock-in. The Core is a conditional, revisable framework rather than a settled theorem.

## Core
- [価値の不確実性と探索可能性の保存](core/) — Distinguishes foundational normativity, inferential best explanations, practical commitment, and irreversible epistemic lock-in.

## Practice and project information
